title: Female Orcas Stop Having Calves at 40, Then Live Decades More
subject: orca

scenes.text: Female orcas stop having babies around age 40, then keep living for decades.
Some live to 90. Almost no other animals on Earth do that.
So what is she for? Researchers followed 378 grandchildren over about 40 years.
When the grandmother was alive, calves were more likely to survive. After she died, the risk of death rose sharply for two years.
And in years when salmon are scarce, older females lead the pod to the food.
In a hungry year, her memory of where the fish are may be worth more than another calf.

description:
Female orcas stop having calves around age 40 but can live to about 90.
A study of 378 grandchildren found calves were more likely to survive while their grandmother was alive, and older females lead pods to salmon when food is scarce.
What's the best thing your grandmother taught you? Comment below.
